name: turbo-charge-no-powercell-click-refused
notes: Turbo Charge (cnqsm3n9yv, CLERIC skill, reserve 3) needs a Powercell to sacrifice; none is on the field and three payers are in hand. REGRESSION PIN, not a failing-first repro: the hand click already consults the generated activate prerequisite (CanActivateCard) before the card moves, so Turbo Charge / Atmos Armor / Overlord Mk III were never stranded by the dead post-announce Powercell check on the hand-click path (it is reachable only through direct DoActivateCard callers that skip the prerequisite). Pins the refusal on state so it stays refused if the prerequisite ever changes.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate Turbo Charge, sacrifice a Powercell.
